affiliations.name: Instituto Superior Técnico (IST), Universidade de Lisboa, Lisbon, Portugal

title: Vagaja2023
description: EEG recordings from 26 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery during MI-BCI training in immersive virtual reality. Participants were randomized to an embodiment-primed (virtual hand illusion) group or a non-embodied control group, and each completed a single run of 40 trials. The dataset also includes bipolar EMG, skin temperature and accelerometry, and is distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a 32-channel active Ag/AgCl actiCAP and LiveAmp 32 amplifier (Brain Products), plus 2 EMG channels and 4 auxiliary channels. Each subject completed one lab session with a cue-based motor imagery run of 40 trials (20 per class) with a 10 s imagery/feedback window and visual feedback in VR.
